data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin for generating sign-in buttons for different social media accounts.
data.what_it_does: Generates pre-styled sign-in buttons for various social media accounts like Google, Facebook, Apple, and GitHub. Provides both built-in buttons with standard branding and custom button builders.
use_when: You need pre-styled social sign-in buttons conforming to platform design guidelines.
You want to quickly add standard buttons for Google, Apple, Facebook, and other providers.
avoid_when: You only need actual authentication logic (this package only provides UI buttons).
You require custom branding that diverges completely from standard social buttons.
strengths: Supports a wide range of built-in social sign-in buttons.
Includes mini button variants and loading states for async actions.
Customizable text and builder widget for unique button styles.
weaknesses: Does not handle the actual authentication logic or SDK integrations for the providers.
Requires manual implementation of sign-in flows alongside the buttons.
data.setup_notes: Add the package to pubspec.yaml dependencies.
